title: PEER REVIEW
officialText:
709.1. General. When required, peer reviews shall be performed in accordance with the
requirements of Section 1618 of the New York City Building Code for structural peer review, and
Section 1818 of the New York City Building Code for geotechnical peer review.
709.2 Structural peer review – where required. A structural peer review of the primary structure
shall be performed for the following:
1. Where the alteration meets the requirements for peer review pursuant to Section 1618.2 of
the New York City Building Code.
2. When the altered building is required to meet the structural requirements for a new building
in accordance with Section 703.2 of this code, and the altered building meets the
requirements of Section 1618.2 of the New York City Building Code.
3. Altered buildings taller than 7 stories where the work involves transferring a column or a
column transfer removal that supports in aggregate more than 15 percent of the building
area, or where the work involves transferring on 1 element a portion of a wall that portion
of which supports more than 25 percent of the building area. In this case, only the design
and sequence of the transfer and related load path, including the method of load transfer to
the subgrade, shall be subject to peer review.
4. Buildings where a structural peer review is requested by the commissioner.
709.3 Geotechnical peer review - where required. A geotechnical peer review shall be
performed for the following:
1. Where a structural peer review is required pursuant to Section 709.2;
2. When the altered building is required to meet the structural requirements for a new building
in accordance with Section 703.2, and the structure is of Risk Category III or IV where the
Seismic site class is determined to be Site Class F.
3. Where performance-based foundation design is utilized in the design of the alteration.
4. Buildings where a geotechnical peer review is requested by the commissioner.
